groups.title: Foreword · John Ray
groups.text: John Ray introduces Humbert's manuscript and the characters' later fates, framing the confession as a moral warning.

groups.title: Part I
groups.text: Humbert enters the Haze household and draws Dolores into a journey marked by his manipulation and abuse.

groups.title: Part II
groups.text: Across American roads and Beardsley, Humbert tries to maintain his control over Dolores. Their separation leads him to seek her out and pursue Quilty.

groups.title: On a book entitled Lolita
groups.text: Nabokov recounts the novel's creation and publication, defending artistic freedom and distinguishing himself from Humbert.
